text: 备受关注的美国消费者价格指数报告将缺少一些关键数据：同比百分比变化。通常，美国劳工统计局公布的CPI报告会显示价格较前一个月以及较一年前发生了怎样的变化。后一项数据通常也是公众理解通胀水平的方式；9月该数据为3.7%。 由于2025年美国政府停摆，周二公布的10月数据将无法提供这一同比指标。
text_en: The closely watched US consumer price index report will be missing some key data: the year-on-year percentage change. Normally, the CPI report published by the US Bureau of Labor Statistics shows how prices changed from the previous month and from a year earlier. The latter figure is also typically how the public understands the inflation level; in September it was 3.7%. Due to the 2025 US government shutdown, the October data released on Tuesday will not be able to provide this year-on-year metric.
